title: Opening Night at the Lyra Theatre
teaser: Korvin never came out for her curtain call after the second act. Her dressing room was locked from the inside, and the lamps around the mirror were still burning as if she would be back any second. The stagehand on duty swears he saw two figures in the wings, but couldn't make out their faces.

habits.label: Smells of greasepaint
clues: There is a fresh, greasy smear of greasepaint on the velvet curtain by the dressing room door. The culprit smells of stage greasepaint.
The director's box, where make-up artists never go, reeks of greasepaint. The culprit smells of greasepaint.

habits.label: Rosin on the fingers
clues: The handle of the prima donna's mirror has a white film of rosin on it, the kind violinists use. The culprit has rosin on their fingers.
The railing of the stairs down to the orchestra pit is covered in pale fingerprints, and it's rosin. The culprit has rosin on their fingers.

habits.label: Burn on the wrist
habits.habit: An old burn on the wrist from the footlights
clues: The buffet girl saw a hand at the counter tucking a purple scar back under a cuff. The culprit has a burn on their wrist.
A towel in the dressing room has burn ointment on it, and Korvin never had a burn in her life. The culprit has an old burn on their wrist.

habits.label: Claque token
habits.habit: A brass claque token in the pocket
clues: A brass token lies in the aisle by the stage, the kind handed out to hired applauders. The culprit carries a claque token.
A brass claque token with a row number on it was found under the trunks in the wardrobe room. The culprit keeps one like it in their pocket.

habits.label: Reads music
clues: Someone has corrected two notes in the score on the stand in the orchestra pit, and corrected them right. The culprit can sight-read music.
The sheet music for the aria in the dressing room has pencil marks only a musician would understand. The culprit reads music fluently.

habits.label: Violet in the buttonhole
habits.habit: A fresh violet in the buttonhole
clues: There are two crushed violet petals on the dressing room floor, yet nobody gave Korvin violets that night. The culprit wears a violet in their buttonhole.
A snapped violet stem lies on the tablecloth in the buffet. The culprit wears a violet in their buttonhole.

habits.label: Drinks Madeira
clues: On the dressing table there's a glass with a drop of Madeira in it, and the prima donna drank only champagne. The culprit drinks Madeira.
The buffet opened its only bottle of Madeira during the interval, and one glass was carried off. The culprit drinks Madeira.

habits.label: Horseshoe charm
habits.habit: A silver horseshoe on a chain
clues: A tiny silver horseshoe with a bent ring was found under a clothes rail in the wardrobe room. The culprit wears a horseshoe charm.
In the dark of the wings the stagehand saw a little silver horseshoe glint on someone's chest. The culprit wears a horseshoe on a chain.

habits.label: Scar above the brow
habits.habit: A rapier scar above the eyebrow
clues: All the stagehand made out in the wings was the pale line of a scar above an eyebrow. The culprit has a scar above the brow.
A wig with a thick fringe is missing from the wardrobe room, the kind that covers the forehead down to the eyebrows. The culprit hides a scar above the brow.

habits.label: Smells of mothballs
clues: A trunk of winter furs stands open in the wardrobe room, and the same smell of mothballs hangs in the dressing room. The culprit smells of mothballs.
The curtain of the director's box smells of mothballs, though it was cleaned only yesterday. The culprit's clothes smell of mothballs.

habits.label: Dancer's posture
habits.habit: A dancer's posture, toes turned out
clues: The dusty boards of the fly gallery show footprints turned out at the toes, like a dancer's. The culprit has a dancer's posture.
The usher remembers a straight back in the wings and a walk with the toes turned out. The culprit has a dancer's posture.

habits.label: Feather fan
clues: A white ostrich feather is caught on the fly gallery, high above the stage. The culprit carries a feather fan.
There's a little feather on the dressing room rug, and Korvin's own fan is lace. The culprit carries an ostrich-feather fan.

habits.label: Signet ring
habits.habit: A signet ring on the little finger
clues: The wax of the candle by the dressing room mirror bears the imprint of a monogrammed signet. The culprit wears a signet ring.
The lacquered rail of the director's box has a fresh scratch, the kind a ring on the little finger leaves. The culprit wears a signet ring.

habits.label: Reads cards
clues: The Tower card from a fortune-telling deck is tucked into the frame of the dressing room mirror. The culprit tells fortunes with cards.
An unfinished spread lies on a buffet table, one card short. The culprit tells fortunes with cards.

habits.label: Wears galoshes
clues: There's a ribbed galosh print on the parquet by the buffet, though the evening is dry and warm. The culprit wears galoshes.
A single galosh with a worn red lining was left under a music stand in the orchestra pit. The culprit goes about in galoshes.

habits.label: Hoarse voice
clues: The usher heard a hoarse whisper by the director's box, like a voice ruined long ago. The culprit has a hoarse voice.
On the dressing table there's a glass of warm milk with honey, the old cure for a strained throat. The culprit has a strained voice.

quiet: The stagehand stood two steps from the dressing room and didn't hear a single creak of the old floorboards. The culprit moves silently.
Someone crossed the fly gallery, where every board echoes, in the middle of an aria, and nobody in the orchestra pit looked up. The culprit moves silently.
sched: It all happened in the seven minutes when, according to the programme, the chorus is on stage and the dressing room corridor is empty. The culprit knows the schedule.
The buffet closes for a stock count five minutes before the bell, and that's exactly when the wings were deserted. The culprit knows the schedule.
tech: The lamps by the dressing room mirror are on, but the switch in the corridor is down and rerouted to another line. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The spotlight over the stage went out for three seconds: a wire on the fly gallery had been shorted. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
strong: A heavy counterweight on the fly gallery was moved by one person, and it normally takes three to lift. The culprit is physically strong.
The dressing room door was barred from the inside with an oak trunk from the wardrobe room. The culprit is physically strong.
tools: The hinges of the dressing room door were taken off and put back, the screws driven in tight. The culprit is handy with tools.
In the wardrobe room, a box of prop daggers was prised open with a chisel without leaving a single splinter. The culprit is handy with tools.
keys: The spare key to the dressing room hangs on the fire warden's nail, but there's fresh powder on its bit. The culprit had keys.
The director's box is locked before every performance, and tonight it was opened without force. The culprit had keys.
perfume: The flowers in the prima donna's dressing room are drowned out by someone else's heavy patchouli perfume. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
A handkerchief found in the director's box smells of thick oriental perfume. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
lefty: The dressing table drawer was pulled out with the left hand: the scratches are left of the handle. The culprit is left-handed.
A music stand in the orchestra pit has been moved to suit a left hand. The culprit is left-handed.
safe: The fireproof cabinet in the director's box was opened without a scratch, and the opening-night takings are gone. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The prima donna's jewellery box with a combination lock was opened on the first try. The culprit knows the safe combination.
passages: Only one corridor leads from the dressing room to the stage, past the stagehand, yet the footprints go into the trapdoor under the stage. The culprit knows the service passages.
A dusty little door behind the buffet leads straight into the orchestra pit, and the dust on it has been wiped off. The culprit knows the service passages.
french: "Adieu, ma belle" is written in lipstick on the dressing room mirror. The culprit knows French.
A programme with notes in French was left in the director's box. The culprit knows French.
cash: The opening-night takings are gone from the box office, yet the ledger balances to the kopeck. The culprit had access to money.
Champagne at the buffet was paid for with a crisp hundred-rouble note from the bundle the theatre drew from the bank this morning. The culprit had access to money.
medic: The champagne glass by the mirror has a bitter residue, and there isn't a sign of a struggle on the body. The culprit knows about poisons.
A vial of chloral hydrate is missing from the theatre doctor's kit, and exactly the right dose was measured out. The culprit knows about poisons.
